description: YouBike / Moovo stations nearest to a coordinate, with live bikes (regular and e-bike) and empty docks, nearest first. Example: lat 25.0478, lon 121.517, city "Taipei".

city.description: City: a TDX code (Taipei, NewTaipei, Taoyuan, Taichung, Tainan, Kaohsiung, Hsinchu, HsinchuCounty, MiaoliCounty, ChanghuaCounty, YunlinCounty, Chiayi, ChiayiCounty, PingtungCounty, TaitungCounty) or its Chinese name (臺北市, 新北市, 高雄市, ...).

limit.description: Maximum number of stations to return (default 5).

want.description: Only stations that are operating and have a bike to rent ("bike", default) or an empty dock to return one ("dock"); "any" lists every station.

name: youbike_nearby
title: Nearest YouBike stations
